description: This file defines an enumeration called ReadPreference for the MongoDB client configuration within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides various read preference options such as PRIMARY, SECONDARY, and NEAREST, each mapped to a specific MongoDB Java driver preference. The class includes a method to retrieve a ReadPreference based on a string input.

classes.name: ReadPreference
classes.description: Enumeration of read preferences for mongo client, mapping to MongoDB driver preferences and providing a method to retrieve preferences based on string input.

methods.name: getMongoReadPreference
methods.description: Returns the MongoDB read preference associated with this enum constant.

methods.name: ofReadPreference
methods.description: Static method to create a ReadPreference enum constant from a string, returning an Optional containing the match if found.
